items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: I used to watch, sit there and watch Simon and Maria.

ctx.x: When you started in music, what was your first instrument?

Yes, my first instrument was bass because it was fascinating to me. I used to watch, sit there and watch Simon and Maria. And my brother, my oldest brother, used to watch this. Don't bother that man. Let him play his instrument. I'll never forget an assignment to my brother. One day, he says, Sam, you don't know. I said, this boy might be a great bass player someday.
Let him go if you want to learn.
